background:
Create ONE original premium wedding invitation BACKGROUND only, a single full-bleed upright image with exact 5:7 aspect ratio, preferred 1500 by 2100 pixels. Title of concept for your understanding only: "Paunova elegancija". Do NOT draw that title or any text.

Visual concept: refined hand-painted peacock FEATHERS (no birds, no people) in rich teal, petrol blue, sage jade and subtle muted gold, on a warm ivory matte ground. Use sophisticated organic fan shapes, delicate detailed eyes on individual feathers, elegant painterly natural textures with restrained gilded fine lines. A flowing fan of 3-5 feathers occupies the bottom left corner and rises only along the very lower side; a smaller balancing fan rests at the bottom right. One tiny matching feather near the upper right, far inside the edge. Airy, graceful and celebratory for a wedding; fresh original composition, not a repeat of floral frames or pomegranates.

CRITICAL LAYOUT: keep the broad central region from x=12% to 88% and y=10% to 80% light, even-toned and clean for a LARGE centered editable text block. Put the decorative weight in the lower 18% and outer side regions; keep all important feather details at least 5mm inside the edge (at least 60px at 1500x2100). The ivory ground covers the entire image edge to edge, with subtle painted color washes reaching edges if needed; no visible paper sheet, border rectangle or outer margin.

NO text, letters, numbers, calligraphy, logos, signatures, watermark or pseudo-writing. NO collage, grid, alternative versions, mockup, paper object, tabletop, hands, perspective or external drop shadow. One invitation background only, perfectly flat straight-on artwork, not a photograph of stationery.
revisions: Revise this exact single invitation background for text-safe composition. Keep its warm ivory, teal/jade peacock FEATHERS and muted gold painting style, but substantially SHRINK all lower feather clusters to at most HALF of their current height, moving them entirely into the lower 18–20 percent of the image. Leave the full central 80% width and upper 78% height completely calm, pale and clear for a LARGE editable wedding text block. All complete feather silhouettes, eyes and important gold branches must be fully visible and inset at least 5mm from every edge (about 4.5% of image width), including bottom and left; no feather touching or cut by the edge. Preserve subtle edge-to-edge ivory background washes and scattered very faint texture. Make the tiny upper-right feather smaller and fully inset. Maintain exact upright 5:7 aspect ratio and original image quality. No text, letters, numbers, watermark, mockup, collage, extra panels, exterior shadow, paper object or perspective. One complete flat invitation background only.

Make one precise layout correction to this same flat 5:7 invitation artwork. Every feather and gold botanical decoration MUST be FULLY INSIDE an invisible central rectangle spanning x=10% to x=90% and y=10% to y=90%. Move the whole lower-left feather arrangement RIGHT by 12% of the image width and UP by 9% of the image height, and SCALE IT DOWN about 25%. Move the whole lower-right feather arrangement LEFT by 10% of the width and UP by 9% of the height, scale it down about 25%. Move the small upper-right feather LEFT by 12% and DOWN by 9%, and shrink it a little. There must be a wide visible ivory gap between every decorative feather/branch and every edge. Nothing decorative touches, crosses, or is clipped by an edge. Retain the edge-to-edge warm ivory texture, teal and muted gold style. Keep the upper central 65% very light and empty for large editable text. This is a subtle luxury wedding background with small, delicately floating corner motifs. No text, numbers, letters, border frame, collage, mockup, table, people, paper object, perspective or exterior shadow.
